assets.name: background
assets.prompt: Game asset: background texture ONLY for existing Unity portrait nut-sort game. Create 1024x2048 portrait, edge-to-edge opaque RGB. Match only the pale honey/cream low-contrast wood background from reference. Flat orthographic tabletop, very subtle soft horizontal grain and occasional tiny grain swirl. Main 90% central area completely unobstructed pale warm wood, no floor perspective, no seam, no plank dividing lines, no frame. Restrained painterly green leaf/daisy hints only in the extreme 3% left/right edges and the four corners, very small and softly faded, no conspicuous dark shadows. Uniform calm lighting. Much less saturated and much less texture contrast than a wooden photograph. This is a background behind colorful gameplay and dense text UI, readability first. NO buttons, NO panels, NO money, NO diamonds, NO nuts or screws, NO any game object, NO text, NO logo, NO watermark. All UI and gameplay will be separate existing objects.

assets.name: core-sheet
icon-sheet
assets.prompt:
Production UI icon sprite atlas for garden woodwork Unity mobile game. Exactly 3x3 grid of nine equal square cells on square transparent RGBA canvas. Each asset centered inside its own cell with 12% empty transparent margin, nothing overlapping cells. No labels or watermark. Real alpha background. Consistent polished casual-game 2D/3D illustrated icons with simple chunky silhouettes, soft bevels and warm rim-light. Warm honey wood/cream/forest green palette except exchange which must retain magenta and blue arrows.
Row1Col1: chunky curved counterclockwise UNDO arrow icon, muted dark brown with cream highlight, no backing plate.
Row1Col2: TWO chunky circular EXCHANGE arrows, upper magenta and lower cyan-blue, no backing plate, preserve two-direction semantic.
Row1Col3: ADD SCREW tool icon, a short shiny silver threaded screw with round gray base, prominent orange plus sign at left, no backing plate.
Row2Col1: forest green gear SETTINGS icon, simple seven/eight teeth and central hole, no backing plate.
Row2Col2: two forest green REPLAY circular arrows, no backing plate.
Row2Col3: thick deep forest green PLUS sign, no backing plate.
Row3Col1: round GREEN inventory badge, subtle wood outer rim, blank center, NO icon/number.
Row3Col2: round cream/wood CLOSE button with clear dark forest green X glyph.
Row3Col3: simple cream video camera play icon with leaf green triangle, representing rewarded ad video, no text, no button plate.
All full visible silhouettes with no crop. Must be sliced cell-by-cell. No text anywhere. This is an asset sheet, not a game screen.
